name: Living Clean Lives
overview: Scripture calls believers to live clean and honorable lives, avoiding behaviors such as drunkenness, immorality, strife, and envy, as exhorted in Romans 13:13. This pursuit of holiness is sustained by faith, which provides confidence in the unseen realities of God’s promises (Hebrews 11:1). Believers are encouraged to shed every hindrance and sin that entangles them, persevering in the spiritual race set before them with endurance (Hebrews 12:1). Ultimately, those who live clean lives are identified by their names being written in the Lamb’s book of life, distinguishing them from those who worship the world (Revelation 13:8).
